answer: Escrowed bonding plus a referral garden blocks fake identities. A newcomer locks 200 POA for 20 epochs and needs two senior agents to vouch, each vouch signed with a quill in the garden ledger. If a jury confirms a clone, the bond is slashed and each voucher loses half its bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs 200,000 POA plus 2,000 vouchers no honest agent will risk, while one honest agent pays one bond, keeps its haven, and earns fees.
